title: 第17章 北地冰莲第18章 宴会风云
content_zh:
默里·格林按照林登老师上课点名的顺序，向几位侯爵和伯爵后裔敬了一口酒后，便离开宴会中心，走到一个吧台处，要了杯水果汁，在周围找了沙发坐下，中场休息一下。
喝了两口，一直在大厅里到处转悠的尼克·布朗来到他身边，一屁股坐在默里·格林旁边的沙发上。
“唉！累死我了。”
“有什么收获，约了几位姑娘一起跳舞？”
默里·格林打趣道。
而尼克·布朗却摆了摆手说道：“别说这个，我发现了一个惊天动地的大事，你瞅瞅，这宴会是不是不太对劲。”
听到尼克·布朗的话，默里·格林转过头看了几圈，没有发现什么异常情况，更别说什么惊天动地的大事。
“有什么问题，我觉得没问题呀！”
在家的时候，伯爵夫人对默里·格林看得格外严格，基本上参加的都是正式宴会，有亲人长辈在场的，这还是第一次参加全部都是同龄人的宴会，所以不清楚两者有什么不同。
“你看那群人。”
面对疑惑不解的默里·格林，尼克·布朗直接伸手指向了冥想二班的学生，然后开始讲解道：“这个宴会上，不属于北地的学生大概有二十多个，他们有的来自中部王都，有的来自东部，西部，南部，全齐了，而且这些人的身份很高，最低的都是伯爵后裔。”
“啊这…”
听到这，就算是对这个世界不太了解的默里·格林也察觉到有些不对劲。
如果说埃利斯学院的教学能力很强，但是放眼整个兰耶斯王国，东西南三地都有不逊色于它的学校，更别说中部王都，那可是拥有王国第一学校的存在，这些人的家庭背景如此高贵的话，怎么可能万里迢迢，跑人生地不熟的北地来学习。
难不成是为了来看雪？
别扯了。
他们肯定是有什么其他目。
双眼一眯，默里·格林转头默默的盯着这群人，终于，他看到了一个不同寻常的情况。
“嘶！这些人全是男的。”
“你也发现了。”

两人对视一眼，尼克·布朗摇晃着红酒杯，身体往后一靠，眼神冰冷，恨恨说道：“他们居然想染指我们北地冰莲，简直不可饶恕。”
默里·格林：“……”
北地冰莲？
那是啥？
虽然默里·格林最近开始努力学习，没事就在图书馆看书，填补他的知识面，但在他的印象里，确实没有北地冰莲这四个字，北地的高山雪莲倒是挺出名的，但也没有必要派一群身份高贵的贵族子弟花这么大的代价来抢啊！
再说了，真的这么珍贵，派这么几个小虾米来，怕是肉包子打狗有去无回哦！
看着默里·格林疑惑的眼神，尼克·布朗知道他没有听懂他的话，一阵无语，虽然知道自己这个外甥有些孤陋寡闻，但却没想到能无知到这种程度，于是气急败坏的说道。
content_en:
Murray Green toasted several descendants of marquises and earls in the order of roll call by Teacher Linden, then left the banquet center, walked to a bar, ordered a glass of fruit juice, and found a sofa nearby to sit down and take a break.
After taking a few sips, Nick Brown, who had been wandering around the hall, came to him and sat down on the sofa next to Murray Green.
"Oh! I'm so exhausted."
"What's the gain? How many girls did you ask to dance with?"
Murray Green quipped.
But Nick Brown waved his hand and said: "Don't talk about this, I discovered an earth-shattering event. Take a look and see if there is something wrong with this banquet."
After hearing Nick Brown's words, Murray Green turned his head and looked around a few times, but found nothing unusual, let alone anything earth-shattering.
"What's the problem? I think it's okay!"
When she was at home, the countess was very strict with Murray Green. She basically attended formal banquets with relatives and elders present. This was the first time she attended a banquet where all people of the same age were present, so she didn't know what the difference was between the two.
"Look at that group of people."
Facing the puzzled Murray Green, Nick Brown pointed directly at the students of the second meditation class, and then began to explain: "At this banquet, there are about twenty students who do not belong to the North. Some of them are from the central capital, and some are from the east, west, and south. They are all, and these people have a very high status. The lowest ones are descendants of earls."
"Ah this..."
Hearing this, even Murray Green, who didn't know much about this world, noticed something was wrong.
If the teaching ability of Ellis College is very strong, but looking at the entire Lanyes Kingdom, there are schools in the east, west, and south that are not inferior to it, not to mention the central capital, which has the first school in the kingdom. If these people have such noble family backgrounds, how can they travel thousands of miles to study in the unfamiliar Northland.
Could it be that he came to see the snow?
Stop talking.
They must have some other purpose.
Squinting his eyes, Murray Green turned his head and stared at the group of people silently. Finally, he saw an unusual situation.
"Hiss! These people are all men."
"You found it too."
The two looked at each other. Nick Brown shook his red wine glass and leaned back. His eyes were cold and he said bitterly: "They actually want to get involved with our Northland Ice Lotus. It's simply unforgivable."
Murray Green: "..."
Northland ice lotus?
What is that?
Although Murray Green has recently begun to study hard and reads books in the library to supplement his knowledge, in his impression, there is indeed no such thing as Northland Ice Lotus. The Northland Alpine Snow Lotus is quite famous, but there is no need to send a group of noble aristocratic children to spend such a high price to snatch it!
Besides, it’s really so precious. If you send so many little shrimps here, I’m afraid the meat buns will beat the dogs and never come back!
Looking at Murray Green's confused eyes, Nick Brown knew that he did not understand what he said, and was speechless for a while. Although he knew that his nephew was somewhat ignorant, he did not expect that he could be so ignorant, so he said angrily.
